tts: Why do companies sell an option that nobody buys?
It's not a mistake. It's a decoy.
The Economist once offered this. Web only, fifty nine dollars. Print only, one hundred and twenty five. Print and web, also one hundred and twenty five.
Print only is pointless. Who would pick it?
Behavioural economist Dan Ariely tested the offer on students. With all three options, 84 percent chose print and web.
Then he removed the useless option. Now most chose web only, and print and web fell to 32 percent.
Same products. Same prices. An option nobody wanted changed what everyone chose.
Next to the decoy, the bundle looks like a free upgrade.
So when one option makes another look like a steal, ask who it's really there for.
